lines.text: Many learners say: I live here since two years.
Better: I have lived here for two years.
Use for with a time length.
For! I have worked here for five years.

data.wrong: I live here since two years.
data.right: I have lived here for two years.
data.why: Use for with a time length.

quiz.stem: I have worked here ___ five years.

en.hook: Do you say “I live here since two years”?
en.tip: With a length of time we use for, not since: “I have lived here for two years.” not “I live here since two years.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I live here since two years.” 😅 With a length of time we use for, not since, so the right sentence is “I have lived here for two years.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
